'''Stephon Javonte Castle''' (born November 1, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2023 class.

==Early life and high school career==
Castle grew up in [[Covington, Georgia]] and attended [[Newton High School (Georgia)|Newton High School]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Hubbard |first=Phillip B. |date=August 22, 2022 |title=Newton basketball star Stephon Castle celebrated across Newton County for gold medal |url=https://www.covnews.com/sports/newton/newton-basketball-star-stephon-castle-celebrated-across-newton-county-gold-medal/ |access-date=June 19, 2023 |work=[[The Covington News]]}}</ref> He averaged 16.6 points, 6.5 rebounds, and 3.2 assists per game as a junior.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2022/04/23/experts-break-down-the-game-of-uconn-mens-basketball-2023-commit-stephon-castle/|title=Experts break down the game of UConn men's basketball 2023 commit Stephon Castle|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=April 23, 2022|access-date=June 12, 2023}}</ref> He finished his senior year averaging 20.1 points, 9.5 rebounds, 4.8 assists, three steals and two blocks per game to carry the Rams to the Class 7A state quarterfinals.<ref>{{cite web |last=Divens |first=Jordan |date=March 29, 2023 |title=2022-23 MaxPreps All-America Team: Cameron Boozer of Columbus headlines high school basketball's best |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/SxUDpqUOuUW4VE3APSX7fw/2022-23-maxpreps-all-america-team-cameron-boozer-of-columbus-headlines-high-school-basketballs-best.htm |access-date=August 5, 2023 |work=[[MaxPreps.com]]}}</ref>
Castle was selected to play in the [[2023 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.<ref>{{cite web |date=January 25, 2023 |title=UConn men signee Castle named McDonald's All-American |url=https://www.journalinquirer.com/sports/college/uconn_mens_basketball/uconn-men-signee-castle-named-mcdonalds-all-american/article_04c2c3f8-9c82-11ed-a213-87684c7aba56.html |url-status=dead |access-date=June 12, 2023 |work=[[Journal Inquirer]] |archive-date=February 7, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230207042517/https://www.journalinquirer.com/sports/college/uconn_mens_basketball/uconn-men-signee-castle-named-mcdonalds-all-american/article_04c2c3f8-9c82-11ed-a213-87684c7aba56.html }}</ref>

===Recruiting===
Castle was initially rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by most recruiting services. On November 19, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] during his junior year over offers from [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]], [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]], [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]], and [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2021/11/19/class-of-2023-four-star-guard-stephon-castle-commits-to-uconn-mens-basketball/|title=Class of 2023 four-star guard Stephon Castle commits to UConn men's basketball|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=November 19, 2021|access-date=May 14, 2023}}</ref> By the end of his senior year Castle had been re-rated as a five-star recruit.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://connecticut.rivals.com/news/stephon-castle-freshman-introduction|title=UConn Hoops Freshmen Intros -- Five-Star G Stephon Castle|first=Stratton|last=Stave|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=May 10, 2023|access-date=May 14, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/high-school-notebook-stephon-castle-is-on-the-rise|title=High School Notebook: Stephon Castle is on the Rise|first=Ignacio|last=Rissotto|website=[[SI.com]]|date=March 3, 2023|access-date=June 19, 2023}}</ref>

==College career==
Castle enrolled at UConn in June 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ctpost.com/sports/uconn-womens-basketball/article/uconn-mens-basketball-dan-hurley-kk-arnold-18128140.php?src=rdctpdensecp|title=UConn freshmen basketball players have arrived in Storrs: KK Arnold, Stephon Castle, and more|first=Christine|last=Butterfield|work=Connecticut Post|date=June 1, 2023|access-date=June 8, 2023}}</ref>

==National team career==
Castle played for the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-18 Americas Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2022/06/03/uconn-mens-basketball-commit-stephon-castle-named-to-usa-basketball-mens-u18-roster/|title=UConn men's basketball commit Stephon Castle named to USA Basketball men's U18 roster|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=June 3, 2022|access-date=June 8, 2023}}</ref> He averaged 5.5 points and 2.2 rebounds per game as the United States won the gold medal.<ref>{{cite web |last=Hubbard |first=Phillip B. |date=June 15, 2022 |title=USA BASKETBALL: Castle, Team USA take gold |url=https://www.covnews.com/sports/newton/usa-basketball-castle-team-usa-take-gold/ |access-date=June 8, 2023 |work=[[The Covington News]]}}</ref>
